info.title: Content Service
info.description: Unified content generation microservice: storyline, narration, shot list, and Playwright scripts

get.description: Combined health check for all components.
Modern K8s liveness probe path (alias of /health/live).

Kubernetes readiness probe -- checks database connectivity.

``db_engine`` is set by the lifespan startup. If startup never ran (or
failed before wiring the engine) the attribute is ABSENT, and a bare
``request.app.state.db_engine`` raises ``AttributeError`` -- which is not a
member of ``_DB_PROBE_ERRORS`` and so escaped to the ASGI layer as a **500**.
A readiness probe must answer 503 ("not ready yet"), never 500. Resolve the
engine defensively and short-circuit BEFORE any query.
Modern K8s readiness probe path (alias of /health/ready).

post.description:
Start storyline generation (async).

Args:
    body: Storyline generation parameters including analysis and mode.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    StorylineJobResponse with job_id and initial status.

get.description:
Get storyline job status and results.

Args:
    job_id: UUID of the storyline generation job.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    StorylineResultResponse with current status and results.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if job_id is not found.

post.description:
Validate and rebalance chapter durations (sync).

Args:
    body: Storyline dict with target duration and overage threshold.
    request: FastAPI request.

Returns:
    ChapterPlanResponse with validation warnings and rebalanced storyline.

Convert critique/review findings into a Storyline (sync, no LLM).

Args:
    body: Findings, scores, and conversion type parameters.

Returns:
    StorylineResponse with deterministically generated storyline.

Build shot list from storyline (sync).

Args:
    body: Storyline dict and analysis input.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    ShotListResponse with parts, recording order, and duration.

AI-enhance shot list actions.

Args:
    body: Shot list, storyline, and analysis for enhancement.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.

Returns:
    ShotListEnhanceResponse with AI-enhanced actions.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 501 if AI creative enhancement is disabled.

Convert a Storyline + findings/reviews into a ShotList (sync, no LLM).

Args:
    body: Storyline, findings, and conversion type parameters.

Returns:
    ShotListResponse with deterministically generated shot list.

Start narration generation (async).

Args:
    body: Narration generation parameters including storyline and mode.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    NarrationJobResponse with job_id and initial status.

get.description:
Get narration job status and results.

Args:
    job_id: UUID of the narration generation job.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    NarrationResultResponse with current status and results.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if job_id is not found.

post.description:
Start per-part narration generation for a shot list (async).

Args:
    body: Shot list and storyline for per-part narration alignment.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.
    db: Async database session (injected).

Returns:
    NarrationJobResponse with job_id and initial status.

Extract narrative hooks from pages (sync).

Args:
    body: List of pages to extract narrative material from.
    request: FastAPI request with app state.

Returns:
    NarrativeExtractResponse with hooks, quotes, and feature highlights.
Generate a Playwright script for a shot list part (async).
Generate scripts for multiple parts (always async).
Generate a template-driven multi-style campaign pack from one analysis payload.

get.description: Return current status + result for a generation job (tenant-scoped).

delete.description:
Cancel a running job (tenant-scoped).

The DB-side cancel is gated on tenant_id matching; the in-process task
cancel runs only if the DB cancel succeeded, so a wrong-tenant call
cannot kill another tenant's in-flight task even if the job_id is known.

404.description: Job not found or already finished

DegradationReport.title: DegradationReport
DegradationReport.description:
Aggregate fail-open signal, read at the TOP of a job/API envelope.

The per-item ``degraded`` booleans below are honest but buried: a caller has
to walk the nested content JSON to find them, and the orchestrator does not.
This is the one field it can read instead. ``degraded`` is the OR of every
item marker; ``reasons`` carries stable codes with counts (see
``src.services.narrative.degradation``) and is EMPTY on a healthy job.

Visibility only — a degraded job is still ``status="completed"``.
